blockingFindings.title: Missing coverage for required rejection cases
blockingFindings.issue: R7 requires tests for run, Issue, and spec identity mismatches, missing flow-level guards, task-scoped stages, every finalize leaf, merge outcome, squash baseline, finalized timestamp, evidence traversal escape, symlink, path length over 1000, file count over 500, aggregate bytes over 268435456, 101st audit record, candidate invariant failure, and byte-identical rejection behavior. The test only covers two source stages, one squash baseline shape, a 501-character reason, and maxFiles: 0.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add executable spec-local tests for each required R7 rejection path and assert no mutation of flow state, source/artifacts where applicable, and audit history on rejection.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage, and the coverage artifact marks R7 covered despite missing required cases.

blockingFindings.title: Missing coverage for exact retry reset semantics
blockingFindings.issue: R3 requires reset markers for every flow-level review and gate retry phase that can be revisited, removal of active retry-recovery grants from eligibility while retaining the prior value in audit, and configured retry maxima remaining unchanged so renewed retry counts start at zero without extra attempts. The test only checks that appended metrics have reset === true and retryRecovery becomes null; it does not verify the complete phase set, renewed counts, or unchanged maxima behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Assert the complete retry reset phase set and verify retry maxima/configuration are unchanged while renewed retry counts resolve to zero without extra attempts.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A required behavioral guarantee has no concrete regression test.

blockingFindings.title: Missing coverage for evidence eligibility categories and renewed route
blockingFindings.issue: R4 requires user approval plus planning, test, implementation, review, gate, retro, acceptance, finding, override, and final-regression evidence at or before the rewind timestamp to be ineligible, and evidence created afterward through the normal route to be eligible. The test only calls a timestamp helper with three timestamps and checks approval status pending.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add tests that exercise each required evidence/approval category as stale before or at the rewind timestamp and eligible only when recreated afterward through the normal route.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Critical evidence invalidation behavior lacks coverage for most required categories and the renewed normal-route eligibility path.

blockingFindings.title: Missing coverage for artifact inventory limits and chunk size
blockingFindings.issue: R5 requires inventory limits of at most 500 regular files, 268435456 aggregate bytes, spec-relative paths no longer than 1000 characters, hash chunks no larger than 65536 bytes, and preservation of product source files and artifacts. The test captures one file and excludes flow.json, but does not verify the 500-file boundary, byte aggregate boundary, path length boundary, chunk size, artifact preservation beyond one file, or product source byte preservation.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add boundary tests for 500 files, 268435456 bytes, 1000-character paths, 65536-byte hash chunks, and byte preservation of product source and prior artifact files.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Required resource limits and preservation guarantees have no corresponding executable test coverage.

blockingFindings.title: Missing coverage for audit cap and required audit fields
blockingFindings.issue: R6 requires at most 100 durable audit records, rejection of the 101st rewind before mutation, and audit fields including invalidated approval confirmation, invalidated retry-recovery value, retry reset phases, and up to 500 invalidated evidence entries. The test checks append behavior and a few fields, but not the 100-record cap, 101st rejection, approval confirmation, retry recovery value, retry reset phases, or evidence truncation/cap.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add tests for all required audit fields, evidence cap behavior, immutable prior records, and 101st rewind rejection before mutation.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A required audit durability and limit guarantee lacks coverage.

blockingFindings.title: R8 self-check does not exercise production behavior
blockingFindings.issue: The R8 test builds a local array of test name strings and asserts its own length and prefixes. It would pass even if production code omitted the required end-to-end fixture, route parity, bounds, reset, freshness, audit, and implementation verification behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Replace the self-referential name-list assertions with executable tests that exercise the required shared/spec-local coverage, including the impl-gate end-to-end path through clarification, renewed review/gate/approval, and required implementation verification.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is a static anti-pattern that passes without exercising production behavior while claiming broad acceptance coverage.

blockingFindings.title: Missing coverage for unchanged pre-implementation and task-level reopen routes
blockingFindings.issue: R1 and R8 require existing pre-implementation and task-level success and failure reopen routes to retain current prerequisites, results, and issue-log behavior. The tests only inspect command options/help and do not execute or assert those existing routes.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add regression tests for representative pre-implementation and task-level reopen-draft success and failure routes, including prerequisites, results, and issue-log behavior.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A required non-regression surface has no corresponding executable coverage.

blockingFindings.title: Missing next-action agreement validation coverage
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires validation before save that exactly one in-progress leaf exists across parent and task scopes and next-action resolves that same draft leaf. The test only inspects the transformed step statuses from applyPlanRewind and does not exercise next-action resolution or cross-scope invariant failure before save.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add tests that invoke the relevant next-action/validation path and assert it resolves the same draft leaf, plus a candidate invariant failure case that is rejected before save.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The key candidate validation contract is untested.

blockingFindings.title: Artifact preservation is not asserted for the command path
blockingFindings.issue: The tests verify that evidence capture reads files without changing them, but they do not assert that a successful `RunReopenDraftCommand.execute` leaves existing artifact files byte-identical. `tempRoot()` creates `prior-review.json`, yet R1/R8 remove the temp root without comparing it after the rewind.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion around a successful flow-level command rewind that snapshots an existing artifact file before execution and verifies the same bytes still exist afterward.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R5/R8 require prior artifact files to be preserved. An implementation could delete or rewrite artifacts after inventory during the command flow and these tests would still pass.

blockingFindings.title: Specific rejection failures are not checked for most invalid candidates
blockingFindings.issue: Most rejection cases use `assert.throws(..., undefined, label)`, which accepts any thrown error. This does not verify the required specific failure for unsupported stages, task-scoped stage, finalize leaves, merge outcome, squash baseline, finalized timestamp, and candidate invariant failure.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: For each R7 rejection case, assert the specific error code/message/envelope that the target API promises rather than accepting any throw.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R7 requires specific failures before save. The current tests would pass if all invalid inputs failed with a generic or incorrect error.

blockingFindings.title: Unsupported non-finalize flow stages are not covered
blockingFindings.issue: The tests cover supported stages and finalize leaves, but do not exercise an unsupported non-finalize parent leaf such as `test-execute` or `test-result-review` with flow-level guards present.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a rejection test for at least one active parent leaf outside the five supported stages and outside `finalize-*`, asserting it does not enter flow-level mode and returns the expected unsupported-stage failure without mutation.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R1 limits flow-level mode to exactly five stages, and R7 requires unsupported stage rejection. Without this case, an implementation could incorrectly allow other implementation leaves.

blockingFindings.title: FlowStore mutation contract is not exercised
blockingFindings.issue: R2 specifically requires FlowStore to apply the flow-level rewind in one mutation and validate the candidate before save, but the tests use a fake manager whose rewindPlan directly calls applyPlanRewind and mutates an in-memory object. This can pass even if the real FlowStore does not implement the required mutation/save behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local test that exercises the real FlowStore/flow manager rewind path and asserts the persisted state reflects the one-mutation rewind and invariant validation before save.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is a static anti-pattern that bypasses the production behavior named by the acceptance requirement.

blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add assertions around a successful rewind comparing these required fields and source file bytes before and after the operation.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The coverage artifact marks R5 covered, but several explicit acceptance requirements have no corresponding executable coverage.

blockingFindings.issue: R4 requires stale evidence to be ineligible while evidence created afterward through the normal route is eligible. The test only calls isPlanEvidenceFresh with synthetic timestamps; it does not exercise renewed approval/evidence being created through the normal flow route after rewind.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Extend the end-to-end fixture or add a focused test that records renewed approval/evidence through the normal route after rewind and asserts it is eligible while pre-rewind evidence remains ineligible.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A key acceptance behavior has only helper-level timestamp checks and lacks route-level regression coverage.

requirements.desc: `senti flow run reopen-draft` shall select flow-level mode only when `currentTaskId` is null and the sole active parent leaf is `impl-review`, `impl-gate`, `retro`, `acceptance-review`, or `final-regression`; that mode shall require a 1-500 character reason and explicit expected run ID, Issue, and spec, while all existing pre-implementation and task-level success and failure routes retain their current prerequisites, results, and issue-log behavior.

FlowStore shall apply flow-level rewind in one mutation: keep branch and prepare-spec completed, set the definition-backed draft clarification leaf to in_progress, set every other parent plan and implementation leaf through finalize to pending, clear their timestamps and runtime metadata, and validate before save that exactly one in-progress leaf exists across parent and task scopes and next-action resolves that same draft leaf.

The rewind mutation shall append reset markers for every flow-level review and gate retry phase that can be revisited, remove active retry-recovery grants from eligibility while retaining their prior value in the rewind audit, and leave configured retry maxima unchanged so all renewed retry counts start at zero without granting additional attempts.

The rewind shall reset the approval leaf and record a latest rewind timestamp; user approval and all planning, test, implementation, review, gate, retro, acceptance, finding, override, and final-regression evidence created at or before that timestamp shall be ineligible, while evidence created afterward through the normal route shall be eligible.

Flow-level rewind shall not delete or rewrite prior artifact files and shall inventory at most 500 regular files and 268435456 aggregate bytes using spec-relative paths no longer than 1000 characters and hash chunks no larger than 65536 bytes; each entry shall contain path, byte size, modification time, and SHA-256 digest, and all product source files, worktree and branch metadata, tasks, task steps, task requirements, task statuses, currentTaskId, runId, Issue, and spec identity shall remain byte-for-byte or structurally unchanged as applicable.

Each successful rewind shall append one of at most 100 durable audit records in flow.json containing a 1-500 character reason, run ID, Issue, spec, source stage, destination step, rewind timestamp, invalidated step IDs, invalidated approval confirmation, invalidated retry-recovery value, retry reset phases, and up to 500 invalidated evidence entries; prior audit records shall remain unchanged and the 101st rewind shall be rejected before mutation.

A supplied run, Issue, or spec mismatch shall return `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` at the shared guard boundary, and missing flow-level guards, a reason outside 1-500 characters, unsupported stage, task-scoped stage, any `finalize-*` leaf, merge outcome, squash baseline, finalized timestamp, evidence traversal escape, symlink, path over 1000 characters, more than 500 files, more than 268435456 aggregate bytes, a 101st audit record, or candidate invariant failure shall return a specific failure before save; flow state, source, artifacts, and audit history shall remain byte-identical on every rejection.

Spec-local and shared tests shall verify all five supported stages, exactly-one-leaf and next-action agreement, complete step and retry reset sets, stale-versus-renewed approval and evidence eligibility, audit fields and append behavior, product source and artifact preservation, each identity mismatch, every finalize and baseline rejection, the 500-file, 268435456-byte, 65536-byte-chunk, 1000-character-path, 500-character-reason, and 100-record limits, and unchanged pre-implementation and task-level reopen routes; an end-to-end fixture shall traverse impl-gate rewind through clarification, renewed review/gate/approval, and required implementation verification.
